reason_summary: Prompt asked to create a parallel threat-response / SOC / incident-response rule-pack / sector-pack / dictionary. KYE already governs AI-assisted incident-response decisions at the action boundary via kye:rule-pack:cyber-resilience-incident + kye:sector-pack:cyber-resilience-incident + kye:dictionary:cyber-resilience-incident, bound to DORA / NIS2 / NIST CSF 2.0 / SEC cyber-disclosure / ISO 27035. A parallel pack is a §0 violation; re-mapping those frameworks is a §70 violation. Refusing the parallel pack.
remediation_hint: Build the agent as a Governed Agent PRODUCT that RUNS the existing kye:sector-pack:cyber-resilience-incident flow under KYE authority (the runtime-kye-sanctions-aml-authority-agent pattern). Add only the agent-product artefacts (§52 binding, principal, product row + fan-out, SKU, pricing, ™, governed-agents.html entry) and BIND — never re-map — the existing DORA / NIS2 / NIST CSF 2.0 / SEC cyber-disclosure / ISO 27035 frameworks via kye:rule-pack:cyber-resilience-incident.
